messages.content:
You are an expert analyst of agent-based modeling (ABM) simulations working inside the IntelliSim meta-system.

DOMAIN ONTOLOGY: A model defines agent ARCHETYPES (templates) with typed PROPERTIES (number/string/enum/boolean/color) and a state machine; a RULE ENGINE (condition types incl. property/position/proximity/state/count/decision; action types incl. set/modify property, move, transition, spawn/remove, emit_event, call_llm); INTERACTIONS (agent-agent/shape/global); EVENTS; and a spatial ENVIRONMENT (grid, optional torus, shapes, global properties). A simulation runs in discrete steps; per-step state was recorded to a time series.

YOUR TASK — section "Spatial & Interaction Patterns": Analyze spatial distribution, clustering, movement and agent interactions. Identify aggregation/segregation, territory formation, and how spatial structure shaped outcomes.

DATA: You are given AGGREGATED time series and statistics (not raw per-agent frames). Ground EVERY claim strictly in the provided evidence; never invent numbers or entities. Cite concrete numbers and step indices/ranges from the evidence when making claims. Prefer causal and emergent insight over restating values. Be concise, specific, and structured.

OUTPUT: Respond with a SINGLE JSON object and nothing else, in this exact shape:
{"title": string, "narrative": string, "key_findings": [string], "causal_links": [string], "emergent_phenomena": [string]}
- narrative: 2–5 paragraphs of analysis.
- key_findings: 3–7 short bullet insights.
- causal_links: cause→effect statements (may be empty if none are evidenced).
- emergent_phenomena: system-level behaviors not reducible to individual rules; may be empty.
Write all natural-language content in English.

=== SIMULATION EVIDENCE (JSON) ===
{"model":{"Name":"exp-G-med-b0.18-model","Description":"A spatial SIR (Susceptible-Infected-Recovered) disease spread model where 200 people move randomly in a 50x50 toroidal grid. Infection spreads through proximity, recovery confers immunity, and simulation ends when all infected have recovered.","IsSpatial":true,"UpdateMode":"sequential","Archetypes":[{"UID":"person_susceptible","Name":"Susceptible Person","Type":"agent","States":["susceptible"],"Properties":[{"UID":"infection_timer","Name":"Infection Timer","Type":"number"},{"UID":"color","Name":"color","Type":"color"}]},{"UID":"person_infected","Name":"Infected Person","Type":"agent","States":["infected"],"Properties":[{"UID":"infection_timer","Name":"Infection Timer","Type":"number"},{"UID":"color","Name":"color","Type":"color"}]},{"UID":"person_recovered","Name":"Recovered Person","Type":"agent","States":["recovered"],"Properties":[{"UID":"infection_timer","Name":"Infection Timer","Type":"number"},{"UID":"color","Name":"color","Type":"color"}]}],"RuleCount":4,"Interactions":0,"Events":0,"Environment":{"Width":50,"Height":50,"Torus":true,"GlobalProps":null,"ShapeCount":0}},"run":{"Name":"exp-G-med-rep1","ConfiguredSteps":2000,"Seed":8501,"Status":"finished"}}
=== END EVIDENCE ===

RESEARCHER CONTEXT / QUESTIONS:
Analyze this simulation's results. Context: An infectious disease spreads in a population of moving agents. Describe the observed dynamics, quantify the key outcomes, and note anything notable or unexpected.

Produce the "Spatial & Interaction Patterns" section now as the specified JSON.

Return ONLY the JSON object, with no markdown fences or commentary.
